column6: January 2026 Division of Water Resources legislative update says 65% of Utah residents are eligible for the Landscape Incentive Program that Utah Water Savers administers; portal still invites applications.
Official conference page lists the 2026 UtahJS Conference as a one-day event on Fri Sep 18 2026 at Jordan Commons in Sandy with $199 tickets and named speakers.
Official Nucleus UTIF page still has Apply Here but no cycle date; newest dated program document is the GOEO UTIF Application Guide updated Feb 2025. No 2026 award list or window found.
Official events calendar lists UZONA Luncheon Colorado City Update on 2026-08-12 among 2026 luncheons and the 2026 Awards Gala; homepage currently shows no upcoming events.

UDOT 2025-10-20 release says the chamber hosted its monthly luncheon Tue Oct 21 2025 at the Uintah Conference Center with a ribbon cutting after. Chamber events calendar on the Wix site had no dated listings.

SHPO Round 3 Rural Revive and Reside packet lists Vernal among rural Utah Main Street Tier 2 communities as of June 2025. Alliance site itself has no dated 2026 calendar; wiki Website points at the city downtown plan not the Alliance.
Official Rise and Thrive page dates the 2026 preliminary round Mar 5 and final round Mar 19 2026 at the Uintah Conference Center with a 2026 prize package; form now closed.
Official VBRC event page dates the 2026 Minnow Tank Pitch Competition for STRIVE graduates to May 7 2026 at Loveland Living Planet Aquarium with seed-funding prizes.

Registry portal at vbr.veterans.utah.gov timed out; only dated public artifact found is the Jan 2023 launch. VBRC still links to Register Business but that page is undated and probe could not verify TLS.

IRS ruling July 2024 for EIN 93-3594150; official site still loads with the Jan 2020 Vision 2050 survey and lorem-ipsum project placeholders. No 2025-2026 program cycle or dissolution found. Wiki still says the domain is parked.
Visit Utah article on the Museum of Utah says the temporary exhibit The Past is Personal runs through spring 2027, showing the consumer travel site is publishing current visitor programming.
WFRC Trans Com page lists 2026 meetings including the next meeting Aug 20 2026 with agenda packet and join links, plus Oct 15 2026.

WordPress post dated 2024-02-26 restarts last-Wednesday masterminds on March 27; homepage meeting notes (June 26, July, Midway happy hour) carry no year and match 2024 weekdays. No 2025-2026 dated calendar found.
Official homepage lists August Chamber Networking Lunch Tue Aug 18 2026 11:30am-1:00pm MDT at Heartlight Funeral Services and posts current membership dues by headcount.
St George News dated Aug 4 2026 covers Utah Inland Port Authority approval of the Greater Washington Project Area with ED director Rusty Hughes speaking at Washington City Hall.
Park Record 2024-10-16 reports Weber Basin Job Corps students staffing Yellow Lake Fire camps. Official center site is live and undated; no 2025-2026 enrollment or graduation artifact found.
KUER 2026-08-06 covers ED director Stephanie Russell kicking off a Weber County nuclear energy symposium at the Ogden Eccles Conference Center on Aug 5 2026.
Official university subdomain announces the Weber State AI Hackathon 2027 competition on March 20 2027 with registration.
WSU magazine Spring 2024 feature is the newest dated program writeup (2023 awards). Application portal at weberwildcatmicrofund.org still invites rolling applications but has no cycle date.
Official homepage lists Women Tech Awards on September 17 2026 3:00-5:00pm at The Grand America Hotel Grand Ballroom; page also stamped 2026-07-31.
Official events calendar lists a May 21 2025 Women Business Owners of the Basin networking event in Vernal and the same-day AI in the Workplace workshop, plus a May 13 2025 orientation.
Salt Lake Sideways profile says Work Hive opened its downtown HQ at 56 East Broadway in fall 2025 and still operates Sugar House; official site still describes the July 2025 move as upcoming.
AllEvents lists a Workbox Salt Lake City Mixer on Thu Jul 16 2026 4:30-7:00pm at City Center 132 S State Street. Official SLC page posts current membership prices from $250/mo.
Official homepage schedules Trade and Tariff Briefings on Aug 14 21 and 28 2026, a Vietnam breakfast Aug 25, and an Ireland Trade Mission Oct 20-28 2026.
